text: Design a 316L stainless-steel lattice unit cell (laser powder-bed fusion) with a solid fraction of at most 26 %, a Young's modulus along the cube axes of at least 11.5 GPa and a shear modulus of at least 9.5 GPa.

oracle.facts: Use 316L stainless steel. The cell size is free.

truth_source: G2 cell schwarz_p sheet 0.25: certified and true for density <= 0.2625, E100 >= 11.58 GPa, G >= 9.56 GPa (results/g2/classification_v3.json); this brief is looser on E100 and G and tighter on density (cell density 0.25).
